shapeSummary: 48 x 24 x 14 mm aluminum block mount: a 6 mm thick plate with a 14 mm central through bore and four 4.2 mm through holes, plus two full-height 8 mm wide end blocks spanning the 24 mm width at each X end.
warnings: No dimensions were scraped; the overall size comes from the estimated bounds.
Block width (8 mm) and plate thickness (6 mm) are guesses from the photo.
Bore diameter and the 4.2 mm hole positions are visual estimates. The photo shows counterbores, which are omitted.
The plate sits at the -Z side; its Z side is ambiguous in the image.
All threaded holes on the plate and block faces are omitted because their sizes and positions are uncertain.
The bore's shallow step or recess is omitted.
cadquery:
plate = cq.Workplane('XY').box(48, 24, 6, centered=(True, False, False)).translate((0, 0, -7))
block_l = cq.Workplane('XY').box(8, 24, 14, centered=(True, False, True)).translate((-20, 0, 0))
block_r = cq.Workplane('XY').box(8, 24, 14, centered=(True, False, True)).translate((20, 0, 0))
part = plate.union(block_l).union(block_r)
bore = cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=-10).center(0, 12).circle(7).extrude(20)
part = part.cut(bore)
holes = cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=-10).pushPoints([(-12, 18), (-4, 4), (4, 20), (12, 6)]).circle(2.1).extrude(20)
part = part.cut(holes)
